works.title: Black Panthers — The Trans-Atlantic Squad
works.note: A large-format piece built like a tactics board, arranging portraits in a formation. Ranked among the largest and highest-value works in the catalogue.

works.title: Speru Peru
works.note: A layered collage portrait combining a child's profile, a crow, mechanical gear forms and an archer silhouette.

works.title: The People of Vaal
works.note: An elder in the foreground, with scenes of everyday township life — a grazing donkey, clay pots, a cooking fire — layered behind her.

works.title: Tarex — The Stand-Out Portrait
works.medium: Mixed media on board, negative-space panel
works.note: A two-panel piece: a seated figure rendered in blue tones, paired with a matching silhouette cut as negative space from a black board.

works.title: Monyakwe wa Batshwana
works.note: A woman in beaded jewellery reaching toward a small jar of craft paint, with dancing figures layered in the background.

works.title: Untitled — Community Piece
works.note: Entered as Mohau's 2025 Sasol New Signatures finalist piece (with Molefi Sylvester Moorosi), titled 'Project Thuthukani — Clean up the trash. Clean up the mind.' Full story on the Studio page.

works.title: Black Panther Series
works.medium: Acrylic and ink on board, triptych
works.note: A three-panel study of black panthers in acrylic and ink, priced as a series.

works.title: Thoughts Unending
works.note: A split composition: half stippled portrait, half a totem-like column of carved figures.

works.title: Dineo
works.note: A portrait in loose ink line and warm watercolour wash, signed by the artist.

works.title: Did You Play?… I Did
works.medium: Pen, ink and acrylic on board
works.note: A cross-hatched figure mid-stride with a football, rendered in a single cyan tone over grey board.

works.title: Assassin's Nest
works.note: A black panther rendered in cross-hatched cyan line, half-hidden behind a tree trunk.

works.title: Ghost Huntress
works.note: A panther in pale, ghost-toned line work, stalking low across a grey-blue forest ground.

works.title: Safe House
works.note: A panther climbing, seen from above, in the same cross-hatched cyan line as 'Assassin's Nest'.

works.title: A Quiet Storm
works.note: A fragmented portrait — headwrap, stippled skin, and blocks of red and green ink.

works.title: Rough Road
works.note: A bare, wind-bent tree rendered entirely in cross-hatched pen line.

works.title: The Gaze
works.note: A direct-eye portrait built from stippled ink over a red pastel ground.

works.title: Miniature Portrait
works.note: A small round-panel portrait in cross-hatched blue line — part of an ongoing miniature series.

works.title: Hang-Ready Print
works.note: A framed, ready-to-hang print edition of a stippled portrait study.

works.title: Smangele
works.note: A painted portrait on canvas. Recorded dimensions in the source catalogue were inconsistent — confirm with the studio before purchase.

works.title: Jomo
works.note: A back-turned figure study in cross-hatched pen line.

works.title: What Were You Thinking
works.note: A folded, cut-paper figure study on a blue ground.

works.title: Self Portrait
works.note: A hooded self-portrait in stippled ink against a red ground.

works.title: Self Portrait
works.note: A muted, monochrome self-portrait in acrylic.

wearable.title: Cross-Hatch Portrait Tee
wearable.fabric: 100% cotton tee, hand-painted with fabric-grade acrylic ink
wearable.note: A cross-hatched portrait study painted directly onto a plain cotton tee — the same line language as the ink originals, on fabric instead of paper.

wearable.title: Panther Study Tee
wearable.fabric: 100% cotton tee, hand-painted with fabric-grade acrylic ink
wearable.note: A single cross-hatched panther study, painted individually rather than printed.

wearable.title: Miniature Portrait Tee
wearable.fabric: 100% cotton tee, hand-painted with fabric-grade acrylic ink
wearable.note: A small numbered run of three, each hand-painted individually rather than duplicated by a print run.

wearable.title: Cross-Hatch Hoodie
wearable.fabric: Cotton-blend hoodie, hand-painted with fabric-grade acrylic ink
wearable.note: A heavier cross-hatched portrait piece painted onto a full hoodie.
